title: City-paid care operators cited by the State, and flagged elsewhere
question: Which operators that the State has cited for serious violations or upheld complaints also carry money signals on this site?
finding: 19 City-paid operators hold State-licensed sites with serious citations or upheld complaints and are flagged in three or more older screen groups. Largest product: Catholic Charities (9 Type A, 8 upheld, 13 groups: autopilot, capacity, claims, daycare, exceptions, expected, federal_flags, leaks, pay, sidedoors, winners, xlink_money, youth_records).
how: Licences in youth_grants "residential and home care run by organizations the City pays" and "publicly funded child-care centres" with at least one Type A citation or upheld complaint, grouped by operator profile, set against the older groups that carry a byOrg signal for the same profile.
limits: Larger operators run more sites and are visited more often. Type A citations are often corrected on the spot. An older signal can be descriptive (size, growth). The City payment may be for a different programme than the cited site.
